[SWS_CM_10255] Variant length field data type
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00202, RS_CM_00211
⌈
If
ApSomeipTransformationProps
.
sizeOfUnionLengthField
is present for a
Variant specified the data type of the length field for the Variant shall be determined by
the value of
ApSomeipTransformationProps
.
sizeOfUnionLengthField
:
•
std::uint8
if
sizeOfUnionLengthField
equals 1
•
std::uint16
if
sizeOfUnionLengthField
equals 2
•
std::uint32
if
sizeOfUnionLengthField
equals 4
If
ApSomeipTransformationProps
.
sizeOfUnionLengthField
is not configured
explicitly, the default value for
SIZE_OF_UNION_LENGTH_FIELD
as defined in [PRS_
SOMEIP_00121] shall be used.
⌋
For the length field of serialization of non-optional members see [PRS_SOMEIP_-
00126].
The type field describes the type of the element. For length of the type field see [PRS_
SOMEIP_00127].
